items.title: Jordan Love: Throws two more TDs
items.text:
Love completed 27 of 45 passes for 274 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Sunday's 20-17 loss in Detroit.

items.title: Jonah Coleman: Team-high nine carries in return
items.text:
Coleman (ankle) rushed nine times for 54 yards and caught both of his targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: J.K. Dobbins: Extends TD streak but outplayed by Coleman
items.text:
Dobbins rushed six times for 23 yards and a touchdown but wasn't targeted in Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Racks up 16 touches in return
items.text:
Jacobs rushed 11 times for 36 yards and hauled in five of seven targets for 55 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 20-17 loss at Detroit.

items.title: RJ Harvey: Catches 52-yard TD in win
items.text:
Harvey rushed three times for six yards while catching both of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals.

items.title: Bo Nix: Scores 62-yard rushing TD in win
items.text:
Nix completed 15 of 29 passes for 222 yards and a touchdown while rushing seven times for 73 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals.
